::: {#def-case-control-study}

#### Case-control study

A **case-control study** is an observational study that selects its participants by outcome:
it includes the [cases](#def-case) of a [population](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-population)
and a [sample](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample) of [controls](#def-control) from the same population,
and then compares the exposure of the two groups
[@me4, Chapter 8].

:::
